text.description_html:
Brass Accents C02-P7990, 6 Inch Traditional Calvin Pull

The Brass Accents 6 Inch Calvin Door Pull has a Mid-Century Modern look that makes it very desirable in today's design world. This Brass Accents Solid Brass Calvin Door Pull has a 6 inch center to center length and a 6-3/8 inch overall length. It is available in stunning finish colors. The 6 Inch Traditional Calvin Pull can be used on doors up to 1-3/4 inches thick. That includes cabinet doors as well as front doors, for a versatile pull that is sure to complete the look of any home with any transitional decor.

Thru-Bolted Mounting: Pull bolts through the door.

Specifications of the Brass Accents Solid Brass Calvin Door Pull:

  • Material: Brass
  • Total Length: 6-3/8"
  • Center to Center Length: 6"
  • Total Projection: 2"
  • Door Thickness: for doors up to 1-3/4" thick
  • Includes installation hardware required for fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.

Sold individually with thru-bolt mounting.
